readOnlyFindings.finding: Speed advances once per simulation time; repeated render frames retain the measured speed. Rewinds, large teleports and suspended intervals reset it.
readOnlyFindings.preserve: Do not introduce wall-clock or render-call-count time advancement for clips.

readOnlyFindings.finding: CharacterClipSampler directly rewrites every track, including constant tracks, after the bind-pose restore; this fixes unchanged AnimationMixer PropertyMixer cache values.
readOnlyFindings.preserve: Absolute repeated sampling must remain deterministic. Existing weight interpolates toward rest, so sequential calls are not a complete A-to-B crossfade.

readOnlyFindings.finding: Each setPose restores the rig; walk phase follows distance divided by stride. Procedural run/crouch/aim/care/fall overlays then apply.
readOnlyFindings.preserve: Keep fallback actions and explicit down/care/carry/restrained/reload/kneel priority. Real cover/fire semantics must not be invented from aiming alone.

readOnlyFindings.finding: World AK attaches independently to the existing procedural weapon socket and retains its original muzzle object.
readOnlyFindings.preserve: If the owner adds a hand-bone follow step, apply it after clip/pose evaluation; preserve muzzle identity and weapon scale calibration and keep FirstPersonArms separate.

readOnlyFindings.finding: The target-baked tactical loader checks original bind-pose transforms and returns an optional lease of 17 clips; it must be called before mounting/sampling the target.
readOnlyFindings.preserve: Tactical-load failure must retain the loaded character and procedural/walk fallback. Late success must release its lease after character disposal.

plannedBehaviorTests: Repeated simulation timestamp produces the same skeleton/skin and does not reset a run or advance a transition.
State changes and clock rewind remain finite, deterministic and do not move the simulation-owned root.
Optional tactical failure retains visible loaded skin, canonical walk and procedural actions without request loops.
Disposed character rejects late tactical attachment and frees that lease exactly once.
World weapon preserves muzzle identity and world-space alignment through tactical poses.

tested: Finite animationTime enables shared run; repeated simulation timestamps reproduce identical skeleton matrices.
Changing animationTime alone does not advance moving clip phase; returning stationary time reproduces the same idle pose.
Missing and NaN animationTime retain deterministic procedural fallback.
Child walk returns to identical pose after crouch/down/care/carry; simulation-owned root stays fixed and shared clip remains disabled.
Controlled optional tactical download failure retains actual visible skin, canonical walk and crouch fallback without repeated requests.
Decoded tactical acquire winning a disposal/abort race releases its lease exactly once and never reattaches.
World AK original muzzle identity, source muzzle alignment, socket scale and one-instance ownership survive shared crouch_idle/crouch_walk/ready_idle and fallback down.
notClaimed: Visual hand/grip/foot contact or PBR acceptance
